reason: Hypothesis: 3-bit weights in most layers should use less memory than 4-bit, while protecting the specified sensitive layers at 4 bits may preserve extraction quality and throughput better than uniform 3-bit. It is the most memory-efficient mixed recipe that avoids 2-bit weights, for which there is no measurement evidence. Rank it for the two-candidate measurement budget alongside int4-g128, the only recipe with demonstrated quality and memory results.
risk: No 2- or 3-bit results exist, and the prior 4-bit result does not establish that either candidate retains 95% of BF16 quality or throughput. Measure both against the unchanged gates; treat this recommendation as a hypothesis, not a result.
